chunks: Al-Qadi Aba Bakr Ahmad ibn Sayyar — he met him in

Baghdad, at the residence of al-Sharif Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Tahir al-Musawi. In the gathering there were more than one hundred people, among them nobles from Banu Ali and Banu al-Abbas, and prominent merchants and others. They were present concerning the settlement of a right due to al-Sharif, may Allah have mercy on him.

key_terms.بَغْدَادَ: Baghdad, the city where the gathering took place
key_terms.قَضَاءِ: the settlement, adjudication, or fulfillment of a matter
key_terms.ٱلشَّرِيفِ: the noble descendant referred to in the report

ai.seo_question: What does this narration show about the social standing of al-Sharif Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Tahir al-Musawi?
ai.summary: This report describes a gathering in Baghdad at the house of al-Sharif Muhammad ibn Muhammad ibn Tahir al-Musawi. It highlights his social standing, as many notable figures, including nobles and merchants, attended in connection with the adjudication or fulfillment of a right due to him.
